title: At the Center of All Our Problems Is Us
coreMove: Replace system blame with one implicated habit you personally keep feeding.
sourcePressure: Argues for implicated participation: systems matter, but ordinary choices for convenience, silence, short-term relief, and compromise keep reproducing the culture people criticize.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Collapsing structural critique into personal blame, or using systems as an alibi for passivity.

counterintuition: numbers versus people as a flat binary
